The starting point

Built on a warm
human welcome.

Common Ground operates eight neighborhood cafés. Its loyal guests value familiar staff and a fast morning visit. Growth made the ordering flow harder to manage.

Illustrative customer and scenario02 / 09
02 / The challengeBefore the redesign
A three-part friction pattern

Growth had a cost.

01

Peak-hour queues

Guests waited longer than they expected during the morning rush.

02

Fragmented handoff

Counter, mobile and pickup staff worked from separate views.

03

Limited visibility

Managers could not see where orders stalled by location.

Rebuild the
handoff.
